pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Great Temple of Amon, Karnak — the colossal columns of Egypt, left behind when Israel departed
pictures.name: pd_roberts_karnak

pictures.scene: James Tissot, Moses and Joshua in the Tabernacle — Judah became God's sanctuary, His dwelling among His people
pictures.name: pd_tissot_tabernacle

pictures.scene: Circle of Juan de la Corte, The Israelites crossing the Red Sea — the sea observed and fled, Pharaoh engulfed and Israel safe on the far bank
pictures.name: pd_corte_redsea

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, The Rocky Mountains, Lander's Peak — the great snow peak, the mountains skipping like rams
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_landers

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — the Jordan turned back before the Ark
pictures.name: pd_west_jordan

pictures.scene: Anton Mauve, The Return of the Flock, Laren — the hills like lambs, the flock cresting the rise
pictures.name: pd_mauve_flock

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, The Fifth Plague of Egypt — the storm of God standing over Egypt, the earth trembling at His presence
pictures.name: pd_turner_plague

pictures.scene: Juan Antonio de Frías y Escalante, Moses and the Water from the Rock — the flint struck open into a fountain of water
pictures.name: pd_frias_roca

lines.text: the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
Why was it, O sea, that you fled,
O Jordan, that you turned back,
O mountains, that you skipped like rams,
Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,
at the presence of the God of Jacob,
who turned the rock into a pool,
the flint into a fountain of water!
